pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Crude Iron Cauldron is a basic vessel used by those beginning their journey into artifact refinement. Forged from ordinary iron, it lacks the intricate spiritual patterns of higher-grade cauldrons but is sufficient for fundamental forging.

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: It can hold up to 10 materials and must be placed directly above a suitable heat source.
